jobDescription: A customer-data platform company with around 900 enterprise customers is hiring into its customer success operations team. The specialist maintains the customer health-score model, prepares renewal-risk analysis and recommendations for leadership, runs the preparation process for quarterly business reviews, looks after the integration between the customer success platform and the CRM, and brings new customer success managers up to speed on the team's tools and training materials. Renewal-risk recommendations go to the VP of Customer Success each quarter, and the team expects every flag to be backed by usage, support and billing data that the account manager can check.
requirements: Maintains the customer health-score model and its input data in the customer success platform.
Prepares renewal-risk analysis and presents recommendations to customer success leadership with supporting data.
Runs the scheduling and preparation process for quarterly business reviews with enterprise accounts.
Manages the customer success platform's integration with the CRM.
Trains new customer success managers on operational tooling and maintains the training materials.

evidence.text: Customer success operations specialist at Orrin Analytics (product-analytics software), May 2021 to September 2024; maintained the health-score model (product usage, support tickets, invoice status) in the customer success platform.
Wrote the quarterly renewal-risk memo for the VP of Customer Success, ordering accounts by health score and contract date and naming the usage signals behind each flag.
Scheduled and prepared quarterly business reviews for 60 enterprise accounts, assembling usage summaries and open-ticket lists for each customer success manager.
Maintained the sync between the customer success platform and the CRM, fixing field-mapping errors after the 2023 CRM upgrade.
Ran a one-hour onboarding session on the customer success platform for each new customer success manager.

Work sample: the anonymised Q3 2024 renewal-risk memo, listing 11 at-risk accounts with the usage decline, ticket volume and renewal date behind each flag, followed by the VP's written reply moving 9 of them into the save programme and asking for weekly updates.

Reference check: the former VP of Customer Success confirmed in writing that the candidate wrote the renewal-risk memos from Q1 2023 to Q3 2024 and presented each one at the quarterly leadership meeting.
Recruiter logistics note: the candidate is available from 4 November and has asked about a hybrid pattern with three office days.

propositions.text: The candidate wrote quarterly renewal-risk memos for the VP of Customer Success and presented them at the leadership meeting; in Q3 2024 the VP moved 9 of the 11 flagged accounts into the save programme.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the memo, the work sample shows the Q3 2024 memo with the VP's reply, and the reference confirms the presentations.

propositions.text: The candidate maintained the customer health-score model in the customer success platform.
propositions.rationale: The resume entry names the model and its inputs.

propositions.text: The candidate scheduled and prepared quarterly business reviews for 60 enterprise accounts.
propositions.rationale: The resume entry describes the preparation work directly.

gold.expectedGap: Onboarding sessions are described, but no training materials maintained by the candidate are documented.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the renewal-risk memo and the VP's documented response as supported evidence; do not extend the save-programme decision into an outcome the sources do not report.
followUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate wrote or maintained training materials for new customer success managers, and what they covered.
